text.en:
The barangay high school located at Barangay Veneracion in the Municipality of Pamplona
Province of Camarines Sur, now known as the Taguilid Barangay High School hereafter be known as Don
Mariano Veneracion Community High School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 27, 1984
